title: Pack Vibora Yarara Elite 24k 2.0 2025 + Paletero Vibora - Vibor-a
description:
VIBORA YARARA ELITE 24K 2.0 2025 PACK + VIBORA PADEL BAG - Great pack of padel racket and padel racket bag to help you equip yourself faster. Discover the potential of the VIBORA YARARA ELITE 24K 2.0 2025. It is a teardrop-shaped racket with an offensive character from Vibora Padel, one of the best brands in the sector. This model has 24K carbon, with a rigid feel and therefore ideal for attacking shots.

The pack includes the shovel and the padel racket bag in the image.
